Questions

Not answered here? Message us and we will explain.

How do I pay?

There is no payment on this website. Talk to us first. When everything is agreed, we message you the payment details, and your files are delivered after payment.

What is a UGC ad?

A UGC ad looks like a real customer talking about your product. It feels honest, so people tend to trust it.

Which platforms are the videos for?

All videos are vertical, so they fit Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts and Facebook Reels.

How do the coupons work?

Type OCNOV99 on the Growth pack to get 12 videos plus 2 free for ₹1,099 instead of ₹1,198. Type OCNOV12 on the Website pack to pay ₹399 instead of ₹499. Type OCNOV67 on the Long-form editing pack to pay ₹432 instead of ₹499. The coupon works on long video editing only, not on short videos.

What do I get in the website pack?

A simple one-page website that shares your information and contact details. Tell us your idea and we will confirm everything before you pay.

How long does delivery take?

It depends on your order. We will confirm the time when we talk.
